text: {"layout":"prose","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":0,"note":"The six-clan and seven-clan lists, the 五名 entries with their two-column glosses, the 左傳 attributions and the 晉八姓 heading all match the page, and no cell or row is written more than once."}

{"layout":"diagram","verdict":"material","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":15,"misread_chars":20,"note":"The heading text (九變/十變, 十八卅好) mostly matches, though 妙 likely misreads the last character of the 十變 line; the move numbers on the board are listed as a jumbled, unordered set with many apparent misreads (e.g. 九十七, 五十五, 八十七, 九十六 don't fit a board whose numbers seem to run only into the 30s–40s) and some numbers missing, but I can't confirm any span as clearly invented."}

{"layout":"prose","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":0,"note":"The transcription matches the page column by column. The bronze-script inscription is correctly marked as not transcribed, and the printed gloss 禾父已 appears once, as transcribed."}

{"layout":"prose","verdict":"invented","invented":[{"what":"假 取於物 若伯魚 有類 取於父 若子同 左傳 申繻對","written":2,"printed":1}],"invented_chars":20,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":1,"note":"The page prints the last full column (假…申繻對) once, but the transcription writes it twice; the first character, 絛, may also have been misread as 條."}

{"layout":"table","verdict":"minor","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":6,"misread_chars":1,"note":"All eight table columns match the page cell for cell with no repeats; the page's margin header 欽定四庫全書 is left out, and the margin number is given as 卷九 where the page appears to show 六九."}

{"layout":"diagram","verdict":"invented","invented":[{"what":"右天後衛","written":1,"printed":0},{"what":"右天前衛","written":1,"printed":0},{"what":"右地前","written":1,"printed":0},{"what":"偏左","written":1,"printed":0},{"what":"偏右","written":1,"printed":0},{"what":"中軍","written":1,"printed":0}],"invented_chars":17,"omitted_chars":16,"misread_chars":3,"note":"Only one 左天後衛 (top) and one 左天前衛 (bottom centre) are printed, so the mirrored 右天 labels and the 偏左, 偏右, 中軍 and 右地前 labels have no match on the page; the visible labels 左後地軸, 左衛地軸 and 左前天衝 (plus several faint side labels) are left out, and the trigram placement and 左地後 are partly unclear."}

{"layout":"mixed","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":0,"note":"The two top rows of numerals, the prose passage and all three grid columns match the page exactly; each cell is written once, as printed. The only change is that the grid's vertical columns were rearranged into table rows."}

{"layout":"table","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":1,"note":"Every printed cell appears exactly once; the only error is 蟻 in 蟻脚書, which the transcription gives as 薤."}

{"layout":"diagram","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":2,"note":"All counts match the page: 9 軍 per border row, 7 甲士 per block and two rows of 4 角 + 4 鉦. The small notes beside the flags look swapped: the page seems to print 黑甲 beside 木旗 and 靑甲 beside 水旗, which is 2 likely misreads."}

{"layout":"table","verdict":"clean","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":0,"misread_chars":0,"note":"The title, the two-line instruction and the three columns all match the page; each column has 上等, 上上, 中上, 下上, 中等, 上中, 中中, 下中, 下等, 上下, 中下, 下下 and 某, printed three times and written three times, and the two-character cells are read left to right."}

{"layout":"prose","verdict":"minor","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":1,"misread_chars":4,"note":"The transcription matches the page except for a few misread characters (不→無, 摛→縞, 謀→課, 羡→渼) and one 布 that was replaced by a repeat mark; nothing is invented."}

{"layout":"table","verdict":"minor","invented":[],"invented_chars":0,"omitted_chars":3,"misread_chars":4,"note":"The page prints 30 data rows (hours 31 to 60) and the transcription has all 30, each once, with nothing invented; there are a few misreads, such as 平行度 二二 written for the printed 二三 in rows 42 and 43, and 一一 for 三一, plus three dropped digits where 〇一 or 〇〇 cells are shortened to a single 〇."}

{"layout":"table","verdict":"invented","invented":[{"what":"四三一 (right-hand table)","written":4,"printed":2}],"invented_chars":6,"omitted_chars":9,"misread_chars":6,"note":"The prose and the left-hand table match the page, but the right-hand table (3 columns) is scrambled: the cell 四三一 is written four times though the table prints it twice (placed in the wrong column), the cells 一二一 and 一一二 from the middle column and the 一二一 and 二一一 from the third column are missing, and several cells are misread (e.g. 二一一 read as 一二一)."}
